<!-- PART 2 -->
<div class="pg-part-header">
  <h2 class="pg-part-header__title"><i class="bi bi-bar-chart-line-fill" style="color: var(--d2t-button);"></i> Part 2: Statistical Analysis for Research</h2>
  <span class="pg-part-header__tag">Chapters 5 – 10</span>
</div>

<div class="pg-chapters-grid">
  <!-- Ch 5 -->
  <div class="pg-card">
    <div class="pg-card__top">
      <div class="pg-card__header">
        <span class="pg-card__badge">Chapter 05</span>
        <div class="pg-card__tools">

          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">scales</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 class="pg-card__title">From Research Question to Data</h3>
      <p class="pg-card__desc">Translating research questions into testable variables, Likert reverse coding, and calculating validated composite scales.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-card__actions">
      <a href="chapter05.html" class="pg-btn pg-btn--primary"><i class="bi bi-play-circle-fill"></i> Open Playground</a>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Ch 6 -->
  <div class="pg-card">
    <div class="pg-card__top">
      <div class="pg-card__header">
        <span class="pg-card__badge">Chapter 06</span>
        <div class="pg-card__tools">
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">scipy.stats</span>
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">EDA</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 class="pg-card__title">Descriptive Statistics &amp; EDA</h3>
      <p class="pg-card__desc">Central tendency, dispersion, interquartile ranges, skewness, kurtosis, and Shapiro-Wilk normality diagnostics.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-card__actions">
      <a href="chapter06.html" class="pg-btn pg-btn--primary"><i class="bi bi-play-circle-fill"></i> Open Playground</a>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Ch 7 -->
  <div class="pg-card">
    <div class="pg-card__top">
      <div class="pg-card__header">
        <span class="pg-card__badge">Chapter 07</span>
        <div class="pg-card__tools">
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">t-test</span>
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">chi2</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 class="pg-card__title">Hypothesis Testing &amp; Inference</h3>
      <p class="pg-card__desc">Independent and paired t-tests, Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, Chi-Square contingency tables, and effect sizes.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-card__actions">
      <a href="chapter07.html" class="pg-btn pg-btn--primary"><i class="bi bi-play-circle-fill"></i> Open Playground</a>
      <a href="chapter07.zip" class="pg-btn pg-btn--secondary" download title="Download Chapter 7 project ZIP"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> .zip</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Ch 8 -->
  <div class="pg-card">
    <div class="pg-card__top">
      <div class="pg-card__header">
        <span class="pg-card__badge">Chapter 08</span>
        <div class="pg-card__tools">
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">statsmodels</span>
          <span class="pg-card__tool-tag">ANOVA</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 class="pg-card__title">ANOVA and Regression</h3>
      <p class="pg-card__desc">One-way and two-way factorial ANOVA, Tukey HSD post-hoc comparisons, OLS linear regression, and residual assumption checks.</p>

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About the Study Case Data
The 600-student dataset used across the playground exercises was synthesized by a computer program to provide realistic empirical properties (including true positive effects, subtle interactions, and honest null findings). It does not represent real persons and should be utilized exclusively for academic learning and methodological practice.
:::
